text.text: Welcome to the Snap'N'Go beta test! :wave:

Thank you for helping us beta test! Snap'N'Go assigns small tasks throughout the day. In the official run you'll get paid; during this beta we can't compensate you.

*Two types of tasks:*
• *Data collection* — Take a photo matching the task. Accept first, then submit.
• *Verification* — Review someone else's photo: click Agree or Disagree on our AI's decision.

*Each task shows:* Start time, window, description, and compensation. TaskBot sends tasks through DMs.

*Submitting a photo (data collection tasks):*
    *1.* Complete the task
    *2.* Go to the TaskBot DM channel
    *3.* Type the task number and attach the image (see below)
    *4.* Send!

*Verification tasks:* Just click Agree or Disagree on the message.
Type `?` or `help` for full instructions. Thank you for being part of the Snap'N'Go beta!
